title: Higher proper direct images of represented Weil sheaves remain represented
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D=(p,a,q,k₀,k) [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l≠p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and finite-type k₀-schemes. Write C(T) for the existing common-stage constructible Weil heart [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], I(T) for the category of all Frobenius-equivariant ind-objects of its underlying constructible heart, and y_T:C(T)→I(T) for its specified fully faithful embedding. Inverse image and its chosen adjoints are exactly those normalized by the Yoneda Kan unit in [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category]. For a proper morphism p:X→Y [def-weil-proper-morphism], n∈ℕ, and G∈C(X), there is H∈C(Y) with y_Y(H)≅Rⁿp_*(y_X(G)). The functor p_* is the chosen right adjoint of ind-pullback, and its higher right derived functor is computed by injective resolutions in I(X). There is no open leg or compactification in this statement.

source.document: SGA 4, exposé XVII, proper finiteness; Bhatt–Scholze 6.8.14–6.8.15; https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.10859; Kashiwara–Schapira, Categories and Sheaves, 15.3
source.place: Barrett, The derived category of the abelian category of constructible sheaves, Theorem 1.1 (ordinary heart, positive characteristic); small abelian categories and ind-objects; proper-image finiteness.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary Barrett realization, including its free-induction inverse-image comparison. Compose free induction with exact ind-Weil inverse image and use the derived free-forgetful and inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions. Construct the right-adjoint comparison as the adjoint transpose of the realized constructible counit. Full faithfulness of the realizations and the two adjunction Hom equivalences show that postcomposition with this arrow is bijective on every represented derived test object. The realization detection criterion makes it invertible. This is the proved private rightAdjoint_restriction lemma.

Apply cohomology to this isomorphism. Barrett realization has represented cohomology, exact forgetting commutes with cohomology, and the standard single-object comparison identifies the cohomology of derived ind-Weil pushforward with the classical rightDerived n. This supplies an ordinary represented carrier.

Transport the Frobenius structure through the ordinary carrier isomorphism. Its conjugate is an isomorphism between Yoneda images; take its fully faithful preimage. The generic lift_fixed_pair helper proves the resulting fixed-pair isomorphism by the conjugation equation. Undo the AsSmall presentation using the literal carrier-and-arrow specification of zlWeilSmallPairs. The resulting object is a constructible Weil sheaf representing the original higher ind image.

lean.statement:
theorem zlIndWeilProperHigher_representable {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (p₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsProper p₀.left] (n : ℕ)
    (G : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω) :
    ∃ H : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl Y₀ Ω,
      Nonempty ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω Y₀).obj H ≅
        ((zlIndWeilPush D l hl Ω p₀).rightDerived n).obj
          ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω X₀).obj G))
